figure_description: A trapezoid labeled ABCD, with horizontal base AB at the bottom and a shorter horizontal side DC at the top. The non-parallel sides are AD on the left and BC on the right. Diagonals AC and BD intersect inside the trapezoid, dividing it into four triangles numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4: triangle 1 is at the top with base DC; triangle 2 is on the right with side BC; triangle 3 is at the bottom with base AB; and triangle 4 is on the left with side AD. Below segment AB is the text "AB is parallel to DC".
